q.q: The Waterfall model is also known as:
q.x: The Waterfall model proceeds in strict linear phases and is therefore called the linear-sequential (or classic) life cycle model.

q.q: Which development approach emphasizes iterative delivery and close collaboration with customers?
q.x: Agile delivers in small increments with continuous feedback, unlike the strictly sequential Waterfall model.

q.q: Which is the correct first phase of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)?
q.x: SDLC begins with requirement gathering/analysis, followed by design, implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance.
